text:
carmen: quick thought 1 let's prototype a "review-queue" for autofallbacks focused on auditability + low-noise triage. collect triggers, score them, let ops take 1-click actions.

derek: sounds useful. how is this different from the quarantine/triage inbox ideas?

linh: main diff: attach a computed "impact_score" (0-100) and an explainable reason breakdown so PMs can prioritize. also strict PII defaults.

carmen: exactly. idea: every autofallback sample has fields: `trigger_reason`, `impact_score`, `score_breakdown`, `route`, `variant`, `decision_trace_id`, `redacted_snippet`. show these in a compact list.

derek: what goes into impact_score? SLO breach risk, user-visible error rate bump, latency severity, and business priority tag from route metadata. weights editable per-rollout.

linh: propose formula in UI: `impact = 0.4*SLO_risk + 0.3*error_rate + 0.2*latency_severity + 0.1*route_priority`. show normalized contributions and let operators tweak weights.

sre-bot: note: enabling full payload retention requires tenant opt-in and will create an encrypted archive in object storage with access logs.

carmen: privacy: redact by default. show only a masked snippet with named-entity tags removed. de-redaction must be explicit and create an audit record (who, why, TTL).

derek: UX: card shows impact badge (low/med/high), reason chips, sample age, and a "suggested action" from the classifier (e.g., "increase timeout to 3s", "route to fallback-2"). operator can Apply / Queue / Dismiss.

linh: suggested-action includes confidence and origin rule-id. accepting generates a proposed rollout patch that goes into a canary preview pipeline; require approve-before-apply for production.

carmen: we should include a lightweight simulation: preview estimated p95 & cost delta after applying suggestion (based on historical traces). quick sanity-check before apply.

derek: storage/cost controls: per-rollout `sample_rate`, `max_per_minute`, `retention_days`, and `payload_level` (none/masked/full). UI must surface expected monthly storage + egress cost for current settings.

linh: sampling nuance: adaptive sampling where classifier-weighted boosts certain reason classes. e.g., base 0.1% but model_error gets x10 boost when classifier_conf>0.8. helps capture rare but serious failures.

sre-bot: telemetry: emit `triage.ingest`, `triage.cluster_count`, `triage.operator_actions`, `triage.de_redact_events`. hook to rollout dashboard.

carmen: clustering: group similar samples (n-gram simhash) and show representative + count. default cluster window 8h. bulk actions apply to cluster.

derek: API endpoints: `GET /rollouts/{id}/review-queue?page=&cluster=&min_impact=&filter=` `POST /rollouts/{id}/review-queue/{sample_id}/action` `POST /rollouts/{id}/review-queue/bulk_action`. each action writes an audit event.

linh: permissions: `review.read`, `review.annotate`, `review.apply`. `review.de_redact` requires `review.audit` and creates an immutable audit entry with operator justification.

carmen: edge-case: very noisy routes. implement a hard cap and progressive downsampling: if triggers > cap, we sample at reduced prob and surface an "estimated miss rate" in the UI so PMs know coverage falloff.

derek: rollback flow: allow pinning a sample or cluster to create a new rollback candidate with auto-generated rationale and links to traces + operator notes; integrate with on-call runbook.

linh: export formats: CSV with metadata + gzipped JSONL for full payloads (enterprise only). exports must include a signed link and TTL.

sre-bot: migration note: enabling review-queue will provision samples table and background clustering job; expect brief migration window.

carmen: small API example to show in docs:
```
route: "/v1/chat"
autofallback:
  enabled: true
  mode: "soft"
  sample_rate: 0.001
  adaptive_rules:
    - reason: "model_error"
      min_confidence: 0.8
      boost: 10
  retention_days: 14
  payload_level: "masked"
```

derek: UI microcopy: be explicit about PII handling. default masked text: "[redacted]" and a de-redact button that says "View with justification (creates audit record)".

linh: monitoring: surface `avg_impact_by_route` and `operator_load` (actions/hour) so we can tune sampling to operator capacity.

carmen: next steps: I'll draft a one-pager + mockups for the console and copy for privacy defaults. @linh will spike runtime adaptive sampling, @derek will enumerate API & RBAC changes. target: proto in 2 weeks.

derek: ack. I'll list endpoint contract changes and perm matrix.

linh: ack. will run spike tomorrow and report perf impact. :coffee:
